query: select 'projects' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_projects union all select 'contributions' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_contributions union all select 'documents' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_documents union all select 'messages' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_messages union all select 'repayments' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_repayments union all select 'payment_transactions' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_payment_transactions union all select 'boosts' as dataset, count(*)::integer as row_count from public.crowdfunding_boosts order by dataset limit 20; select id, nom, secteur, pays, statut, montant_recherche, montant_collecte, porteur_id, created_at from public.crowdfunding_projects order by created_at desc limit 20; select id, provider_ref, user_id, project_id, contribution_id, amount, currency, status, created_at from public.crowdfunding_payment_transactions order by created_at desc limit 20; select id, projet_id, investisseur_id, type, montant, created_at from public.crowdfunding_contributions order by created_at desc limit 20;
